table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	itemname 	= dbo.item.name, 
	aliasname 	= dbo.item.customicode,
	icode = dbo.item.icode,
	date 		= dbo.purledger.date,	
	PurchaseCategory = CASE WHEN dbo.purledger.PurCatCode <=2 THEN 'P' ELSE 'L' END,
	purinvcode = dbo.purledger.purinvcode,
	suppinvcode= dbo.purledger.suppinvcode, 		
	supplier 	= dbo.accounts.name,
	packing    = dbo.item.packingdesc,
	Batch 	 	= dbo.purdetail.batch,	
	Expiry	 	= dbo.purdetail.expiry,
	rate       = dbo.purdetail.purprice, 
	discperc	= dbo.purdetail.discperc,
	unitsalestax = dbo.purdetail.unitsalestax,
	gstperc    = dbo.purdetail.gstperc,
	ItemDisc	= ((dbo.purdetail.looseqty + dbo.purdetail.packqty) * dbo.purdetail.purprice) * (dbo.purdetail.discperc * .01),
	qty 		 	= dbo.purdetail.looseqty + dbo.purdetail.packqty,
	bonus		= dbo.purdetail.bonusqty
FROM
	dbo.purledger, 
	dbo.purdetail,
	dbo.item,    
	dbo.accounts
WHERE
	:al_allitems = 0 and 
	dbo.purledger.date >= :ad_StartDate and
	dbo.purledger.date <= :ad_EndDate  and
	dbo.purledger.purinvcode = dbo.purdetail.purinvcode and  
	dbo.purledger.suppcode = dbo.accounts.acccode and  
	dbo.purledger.suppcode IN (:ai_suppcode) and 
	dbo.purdetail.icode IN (:al_icode) AND
	dbo.purdetail.icode = dbo.item.icode
UNION ALL
SELECT 
	itemname 	= dbo.item.name, 
	aliasname 	= dbo.item.customicode,
	icode = dbo.item.icode,
	date 		= dbo.purledger.date,	
	PurchaseCategory = CASE WHEN dbo.purledger.PurCatCode <=2 THEN 'P' ELSE 'L' END,
	purinvcode = dbo.purledger.purinvcode,
	suppinvcode= dbo.purledger.suppinvcode, 		
	supplier 	= dbo.accounts.name,
	packing    = dbo.item.packingdesc,
	Batch 	 	= dbo.purdetail.batch,	
	Expiry	 	= dbo.purdetail.expiry,
	rate       = dbo.purdetail.purprice, 
	discperc	= dbo.purdetail.discperc,
	unitsalestax = dbo.purdetail.unitsalestax,
	gstperc    = dbo.purdetail.gstperc,
	ItemDisc	= ((dbo.purdetail.looseqty + dbo.purdetail.packqty) * dbo.purdetail.purprice) * (dbo.purdetail.discperc * .01),
	qty 		 	= dbo.purdetail.looseqty + dbo.purdetail.packqty,
	bonus		= dbo.purdetail.bonusqty
FROM
	dbo.purledger, 
	dbo.purdetail,
	dbo.item,    
	dbo.accounts
WHERE
	:al_allitems = 1 and 
	dbo.purledger.date >= :ad_StartDate and
	dbo.purledger.date <= :ad_EndDate  and
	dbo.purledger.purinvcode = dbo.purdetail.purinvcode and  
	dbo.purledger.suppcode = dbo.accounts.acccode and  
	dbo.purledger.suppcode IN (:ai_suppcode) and 
	dbo.purdetail.icode = dbo.item.icode
ORDER BY
	dbo.item.name,
	dbo.item.customicode,
	dbo.item.icode,
	dbo.purledger.purinvcode, 
	dbo.purledger.date, 
	dbo.purledger.suppinvcode, 
	dbo.accounts.name, 
	dbo.purdetail.batch,
	dbo.purdetail.expiry

objects.name: c_salestaxvalue
objects.expression: Round ( ( qty + bonus ) * unitsalestax + Round ( c_netamount * gstperc * 0.01, 2 ) , 2)
